meanings.en: to sort out, to settle, to deal with

В + prepositional. Prefix 'раз-' ('apart, un-, thoroughly') indicates distribution or intensive action (stem 'обраться'). Reflexive/intransitive verb with the postfix '-ся'/'-сь' (historically from the reflexive pronoun 'себя', oneself).
